tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbu mdzad byams pa bstan 'dzin bar sdings rdzong chung la phebs skabs kyi spyi 'gro'i khra gzhi/ shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / ngag dbang kun dga' dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / ngag dbang kun dga' phan bde rgya mtsho theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam gsum gyi yi ge bar sdings chung dkar po sa dge khung mtshon khe nye 'brel mtshungs mchod gnas don gnyer tshang mar springs pa/ rdzong chung 'di pa sngon dus sde bdag zhig gis btsan rdzong ngam/ yang na thugs dam pa zhig gis dben gnas lta bu yin 'dug par gdan sa chen po'i chos sde'i khrod nas/ gnas 'dzin pa re 'byon srol 'dug pa nged rang dran dus lha khang chen mo'i rab 'byams pa lugs zung shes byar mi dman tsam ngag dbang bsod nams des 'dzin skabs 'dug par mchod gnas 'pher ba sogs mkho chen rang 'dug cing / de rjes tshul khrims 'di pa lha khang chen mo'i bsgrigs khrod nas yin pa bzhin kho pa klog bzang ba sogs kyis lo du mar der bebs chod nges byung song rgad pos khur ma theg tshab dpal sa skya'i ban gtsang dbu mdzad byams pa bstan 'dzin 'di pa shes rab go ba skad bcas bzang zhing bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin phyag len yeng thang can rang yin yang / las tshan 'gan 'khur dka' tsam byung song ba nas khong la sngar byas bdag rgyan tshul dang / lhag par de phyogs mchod gnas dkon por phan thogs lhag bsam kho nas ched rdzong bgyis pa 'di pas kun rig tshe chog grub rgyal/ bla ma zhi khro sogs chos 'chad 'dra yang thub nges dang / grwa tog gis mtshon klog 'don thogs med dang / lha bsangs/ bskang gso kun 'byung bzhi/ brgya bzhi sha brgya zan brgya sogs glud chog rnams kyang shes pa dang / gtor bzlog sri gnon/ gtad hrul sogs kyang 'byung zhing /

gdon 'grol byad grol sogs shes pa dang / rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs mdor na mchod gnas 'dod dgu yong tshad 'di par nye mkho'i chas 'dra yang 'di nas btang yod pas rgyun du mchod gnas rang rtsal 'don dang / skabs mtshams su mtshams zhag bdun/ zla gang tsam mdzad song na dang / res 'ga' dpal sa skyar byon nas zhag zla ji thogs sdod 'jug rogs kyis me shing gi mtshon mthun rkyen gang 'grub thag ring 'gro skabs zhon khal phan thogs byed pa sogs mdor na khyed sbyin bdag kun la bstsal gdams byas yin la 'di par dbu 'don yang dag yong bar gyis/ zhes dge byed chu stag smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bdun la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang yang steng nas sa skya pa kun blos zor 'dzin sngon 'gro'i thun dbar la mgyogs bris su bgyis// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dbu mdzad byams bstan bar sdings rdzong chung la phebs skabs kyi spyi 'gro'i khra gzhi/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
